_comment: Pre-registered objective acceptance thresholds for candidate models. These are fixed BEFORE a training run and before any evaluation results are seen; they are never tuned after results exist. The verdict computed from them is ADVISORY: it states objectively whether a candidate meets the research bar, but a human expert still decides whether to promote/activate/use the model (the lifecycle experimental -> ... -> approved -> active stays manual).

rationale.test_size_min: Evidence floor: below this held-out test size the verdict is INCONCLUSIVE (no statistically meaningful support). 10% of a full 2000-image dataset is 200, so 30 is a conservative floor for smaller pilot runs.
rationale.accuracy_min: Overall accuracy must clear a comfortable margin above chance (0.25 for 4 classes).
rationale.macro_f1_min: Macro-average F1 guards against accuracy being inflated by guessing the majority class.
rationale.per_class_f1_min: No class may be silently neglected: worst-class F1 must stay reasonable.
